question: Who is far excluded from nonduality, and who may yet face Shiva?
premises: they from difference-only coursing, in nonduality far excluded
but from the great Lord's freedom
inference: Difference-coursers miss nonduality; freedom may still turn them Shiva-ward.
plain_english: They indeed from difference-only coursing, in nonduality far excluded — but from the great Lord's freedom, they too, if Shiva-facing.
